2390-3514-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3514-6191.description:
Gain life.
Karlov of the Ghost Council triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

647-2137-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
647-2137-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

1434-2436-4116-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn and Glider Bairn have at least one counter on them.
1434-2436-4116-4687.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing Volrath to become a copy of Marwyn until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing Volrath to become a copy of Glider Bairn until end of turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, proliferating all the counters on target permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-6754-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6754-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1496-1981-2415-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1170-2099-5131-7729--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-7729--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2248-3478-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

2921-2946-4871-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2921-2946-4871-7316.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4644-6479-7791.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.

215-527-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2438-3175-4775.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

661-3685-4659-6289.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Voyager Quickwelder. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

38-1869-1916.description:
Cast Changeling Titan by paying {4}{G}.
Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Titan with haste.
The token Changeling Titan enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Titan.
The nontoken Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Titan trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Titan token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Titan from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1402-2981-3593-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

628-6797-7198.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

372-2438-4681.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2783-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2783-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

631-4050-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-1409-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-1409-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Sakashima by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
When Sakashima enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Sakashima.
Repeat each turn.

647-2457-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2781-3388.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Moritte of the Frost.
2781-3388.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Moritte of the Frost. Choose to have Moritte of the Frost enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

590-678-5670.description:
Cast Cathedral Sanctifier by paying {W}.
When Cathedral Sanctifier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cathedral Sanctifier
When Cathedral Sanctifier dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cathedral Sanctifier from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3204-4251-4364-5223.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4251-4364-5223.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
413-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
413-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

643-1636-4832.easyPrerequisites: Ensoul Artifact attached to Maskwood Nexus.
643-1636-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
643-1636-4832.description:
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2302-3101-3440-4867-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You have an amount of mana available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
"Red" chosen with Painter's Servant.
2302-3101-3440-4867-5256.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve Demonic Gifts.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cormela's power.
Repeat.

969-1170-1171.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
969-1170-1171.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

1940-2034-4871-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself, Liliana, and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

126-1173-2825.notablePrerequisites: Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
126-1173-2825.description:
Pay {2} and tap Elite Arcanist to cast Final Fortune.
Pass the turn.
Pay {2} and tap Elite Arcanist to cast Final Fortune.
Pass the turn.
With the lose the game trigger on the stack, tap Obeka to end the turn.
Repeat steps 3-5.

65-717-2628-2993-4310.description:
Activate Blasted Landscape's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Blasted Landscape, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasted Landscape trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Stoic Builder.
Stoic Builder enters the battlefield, returning Blasted Landscape from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
